_redact_comment: TAIL OS is not a public project. These patterns are stripped from every document before rendering, and the build fails if one survives into the output.

home._comment: Front-page claims. Everything here is asserted to the public without a citation, so it must be true and checkable in the published documents. quickstart is omitted until there is a command a reader without repository access can actually run.
